subject: Clarion Health — request to hold inference demo (launch sprint reprioritization)
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@clarionhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion Health — inference demo next week

Hi Logan,

Quick update from our side — we just locked a firm launch window for an internal product update that starts next week and it pulled most of our engineering bandwidth. Given that, we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference POC for the short term and put the demo on hold.

Would you mind pausing our scheduled session and keeping us on a low-priority nurture cadence? I expect we can reassess in ~8–12 weeks once the launch stabilizes.

I attached an excerpt from our Q4 roadmap so you can see the timing pressure. Happy to share more context if it helps with future scheduling.

Thanks for understanding — and apologies for the last-minute change.

—
Priya Rao
Senior PM, Innovation
Clarion Health
priya@clarionhealth.com

Attachments:
- clarion_q4_roadmap_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- clarion_procurement_timeline.xlsx (Excel, 34KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.example>
To: Priya Rao <priya@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarion Health — inference demo next week

Thanks for the heads up, Priya — and congrats on the launch milestone. Completely understand the reprioritization.

We can pause the demo and set up a lightweight check-in cadence instead so the opportunity doesn't grow cold. Suggested next steps:
- I'll mark the pilot as "standby" and remove our live demo from the calendar.
- Marissa (cc'd) will add Clarion to our low-priority nurture list and we can send a short update in 6 weeks, then again at 12 weeks unless you ask us to stop.
- If it helps, Karthik can prep a 20-minute async recording of the demo surface you can watch on your timeline; we can reserve a 30-min live Q&A for when you're ready.

If you have a preferred re-evaluation date, I can add a reminder to my calendar and we can reach back then. Otherwise I'll follow the 8–12 week cadence you suggested.

No problem on the attachments — thanks for sharing the roadmap context. Wishing you a smooth launch week.

Best,
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.example
